evidence.note: sizesIsExactlyAuto is O.exists(stringAttributeValue(sizesValue), exact auto). stringAttributeValue is htmlAttributeValue then isString, so auto implies a present sizes string.
hasAttribute is O.isSome(htmlAttributeValue). Img.sizes is Option<string>, so sizesIsExactlyAuto implies hasSizes; auto-without-presence is unreachable.
missingSizes is width-profile && !hasSizes, so missingSizes implies !hasSizes and cannot combine with sizesIsExactlyAuto.
incompatibleSizes is O.exists(sourceSizeAnalysis), which flatMaps stringAttributeValue; Some(analysis) implies hasSizes. Concatenating issue arrays does not make missing&&incompatible representable.

notes: Correction of r25 img-sizes-auto-presence D1. sizesIsExactlyAuto is an additional correlated member of html-img-sizes-disposition (auto=>hasSizes), not a second owner. Six reachable 4-tuples: absent-ok, absent-missing, and both present-ok/present-incompatible with auto true or false. Designed 4-state literalkit still classifies issue emission; auto stays a present-arm predicate input with loadingIsLazy. Parent owns canonical inventory/design.

evidence.note: imageSizesIncompatible is O.exists(sourceSizeAnalysis(imageSizesValue), ...). Combined-true is the present-incompatible path; incompatible-without-presence never appears.
sourceSizeAnalysis flatMaps stringAttributeValue (htmlAttributeValue then isString) then inspectSourceSizeList success. Some(analysis) implies a present imagesizes string.
hasImageSizes is hasHtmlAttribute, O.isSome(htmlAttributeValue). Link.imagesizes is Option<string>, so imageSizesIncompatible implies hasImageSizes.
